description: Ground-truth dataset for evaluating Veritas fact-check accuracy. Each item pairs a short video URL with the canonical verdict a competent human fact-checker would give. Source domains are the sites we'd expect Veritas to cite for credible evidence. Fill in the video_url fields with real, short (<5 min) TikTok/Instagram/X links that make the listed claim.

items.claim: The United States landed humans on the moon in 1969 (Apollo 11).
items.notes: Control case — any fact-checker should return 'true'. If Veritas fails this, the pipeline is broken.
Control case for obvious falsity. Video: @tiktokconspiraciestv arguing Earth is flat.
